_comment: Phase 2D.2 Dueling Double DQN under act-v3 — Stage A, from scratch, 1,996,800 decisions (166,400 cycles x 12 environments), one gradient update per cycle once the replay holds 10,000 transitions. n = 16, gamma = 1, PER (alpha 0.6, beta 0.4 -> 1.0 over the budget, eps 1e-6, capacity 500,000), batch 256, Adam 3e-4 / eps 1e-5, clip 0.5, Huber, hard target copy every 2,500 updates, epsilon 1.0 -> 0.05 over the first 1,000,000 decisions.
